newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices edge up, tracking U.S..
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices edge up, tracking U.S..

text.p: Danish bond prices firmed on Tuesday, encouraged by modest gains on the U.S. treasury market and foreign interest in medium-term Danish paper.
"Sentiment continues to be positive and there are no indicators on the diary Tuesday which could push prices down," a dealer said.
At 0715 GMT the new benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 traded at 103.60, yielding 6.50 percent, up from Monday's 103.58.
The outgoing benchmark eight percent 2006 bond stood at 111.110, up 0.04 point, yielding 6.31 percent.
